headline: Apple's 'Minions' system pools idle Mac GPUs for AI tasks
summary: Apple researchers built a system called Minions that unites GPU resources from disparate macOS devices, running AI inference jobs on idle Apple Silicon Macs when dedicated GPUs are scarce.

claims.statement: Apple built a system called Minions that pools GPU resources from multiple Mac devices for AI tasks.

sources.quote: Apple unleashes a swarm of Mac Minions to share GPU resources for large AI tasks
The company unites resources from disparate macOS devices
Apple researchers turn idle Macs into a virtual GPU cloud with ‘Minions’

claims.statement: Minions runs AI inference jobs on idle Apple Silicon Macs when GPUs are scarce.
